description: Lower-level: add a content block to a specific slide. Block types: text (Tiptap JSON in `content`), interactive (viz HTML in `html`), html (static HTML in `html`), table (JSON in `content`), shape (params in `content`: {kind: rect|rounded|ellipse|diamond|line|arrow, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, text, textColor, fontSize}). Placement: on slot layouts use `slot` (title, text, viz, caption); on a `freeform` slide pass x/y/width/height (logical 1920x1080 canvas coordinates) plus optional zIndex/rotation instead — users can then drag/resize every block in the editor like PowerPoint. Use `groupId` (slash-delimited path, outermost first, e.g. "chart" or "chart/row1") to group related freeform blocks: in the editor a click selects the whole group and drags it as a unit, double-click descends into it, and Ungroup dissolves one level — give every multi-object figure a shared groupId. Freeform + native blocks (text/shape/table) is the HUMAN-EDITABLE way to build decks; `add_slide_graphic` (one big html block) looks polished but is opaque to editors. NOTE: on slot layouts, Tiptap `text` blocks and `split-*`/`title-body` text slots often don't render in Present mode.

content.description: For text/table/shape blocks: the JSON content

groupId.description: Freeform slides: group membership path, slash-delimited outermost-first (e.g. 'chart' or 'chart/row1'). Blocks sharing a path prefix select/move as one unit in the editor.

height.description: Freeform slides: height in canvas units

html.description: For interactive/html blocks: the HTML string

slot.description: Named layout slot (slot layouts only). Omit to auto-place.

sortOrder.description: Position within the slide (0-based). Omit to append.

width.description: Freeform slides: width in canvas units

x.description: Freeform slides: left edge on the 1920x1080 canvas

y.description: Freeform slides: top edge on the 1920x1080 canvas

zIndex.description: Freeform slides: stacking order (higher = on top)

name: add_slide_block
